tapin.grounded_script: Ilia Topuria defends the featherweight title against Justin Gaethje at UFC 350. Topuria is undefeated at 16-0 with 14 finishes. Gaethje earned the shot by knocking out Dan Hooker in round two in May. The fight headlines the card at the T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas.
tapin.ungrounded_script: Ilia Topuria defends against Justin Gaethje at UFC 350. Conor McGregor crashed the presser and promised a six million dollar purse, then named Emma Frost as the new ring-girl.

moneywise.grounded_script: The Federal Reserve cut its benchmark rate by 25 basis points to a 4.00-4.25 percent target range. High-yield savings accounts averaged 4.1 percent APY before the cut. Analysts expect two more cuts before year end. Savings yields typically fall within weeks of a Fed cut.
moneywise.ungrounded_script: The Federal Reserve cut rates, so Elon Musk is splitting Tesla stock and a secret Bitcoin ETF will double your savings APY overnight.
